name: signal-domain-signal-cannot-connect-to-a-heat-port
source:
COMPONENT SigConst(out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k
END
COMPONENT SigGain(in, out)
  PARAM k
  out.sig = k * in.sig
END
COMPONENT SigSum(in1, in2, out)
  out.sig = in1.sig + in2.sig
END
SigConst   SRC(k=300)
ThermalMass M(C=100, T0=300)
connect(SRC.out, M.port)

error.message: connect(src.out, m.port): cannot connect a signal port (src.out) to a heat port (m.port) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
